messages:
Incident Bot: pager: metering.alerts.high_token_drift triggered for billing.prod in eu-west-1 — severity: P2 (automated)
Sam Cox: @here I'm on it, taking initial triage. Seeing a sudden +4% token delta in the shadow ledger compared to live tallies.
Maya Chen: any customer-facing alerts yet? :eyes:
Sam Cox: Not yet. Overflagging started ~2026-02-18T03:10Z, emits delayed by ~300s in the ingest pipeline. Could explain duplication.
Jorge Alvarez: checking emitter logs now — tail shows repeating ack timeouts to emitter-aggregator-2
Jorge Alvarez: log snippet:
```
2026-02-18T03:09:12Z emitter-agg-2 ERROR ack timeout id=0x7f3c retry=2
2026-02-18T03:09:45Z emitter-agg-2 WARN replay window overlap seq=1245..1252
```
Rajesh Patel: quantified impact on billing counts: provisional delta +3.9% tokens for the last hour, embeddings unaffected. Likely double-emits from retry + delayed dedupe window.
Sam Cox: mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter-agg-2 out of rotation, 2) enable dedupe-strict for 10m, 3) run quick reconsile job to flag false overages. Rolling now.
Maya Chen: pause command executed: `./infra/eject-node emitter-agg-2 --env prod --region eu-west-1` — echo OK
Billing Bot: shadow-emit reconciliation job started job_id=recon-1768459 - estimated 12m
Jorge Alvarez: eject confirmed, traffic rebalanced. Watch for emit backlog draining (metrics: emitter_queue_len)
Sam Cox: queue_len dropping. Reconciler shows duplicates being marked. ETA for clean counts ~8m.
Maya Chen: Customer impact assessment: temporary overage flags for ~2k accounts; most are noise but two customers reported early billing alerts. I'm preparing a short notif.
Rajesh Patel: recommend issuing a proactive note to affected customers once we confirm dedupe; propose message: "We observed transient billing flagging due to ingestion retries; no billed overages will be charged while we reconcile."
Sam Cox: Agreed. I'll draft and send via CS after final reconciliation. Postmortem owner: @Jorge. Follow-ups: investigate root cause of ack timeouts and consider lowering retry windows + improving idempotency keys.
Incident Bot: incident status -> mitigated; monitoring -> observing for 30m. Please add notes to the ticket: INC-1768459.
